story: As a shopper, I want to sign in to Aurora Storefront on any device so that I can reach my orders wherever I am.

rules.reason: Playwright can't emulate Firefox on mobile devices.
Playwright can't emulate Firefox on mobile devices.
Edge tablet profiles aren't available in Playwright.
A guest has no account to sign in with.

reasons.browser: Sign-in uses a password manager hint that behaves differently per browser.
reasons.device: The story says any device, and the form reflows below 768 px.
reasons.role: Store admins land on a different page after signing in.
reasons.language: Arabic flips the whole layout right to left.
reasons.signed in: Half the story is about what a signed-out shopper sees.
